assumptions.statement: The repository provides a rough provisional overall polygon and three unanchored rectangular key-area geometries, not official redlines or parcels.
assumptions.impact: All spatial layers are low-confidence concept carriers and must be regenerated when canonical geometry is published.

assumptions.statement: Statutory land use, title, building survey, road redlines, utilities, fire, drainage, heritage and approved development controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No proposed module, route, area ratio or point is an approval, construction instruction or confirmed site.

assumptions.statement: GB/T 8939-2018 remains current on 2026-08-12; GB/T 8939-2025 is published but takes effect on 2027-01-01.
assumptions.impact: Procurement must verify the current applicable standard at purchase and include a standard-switch review; this proposal is not product certification.

assumptions.statement: Only sealed, traceable, in-date products acquired through an accountable procurement channel may enter a real pilot.
assumptions.impact: Damaged, expired, untraceable or recalled batches enter QUARANTINED; AI and volunteers cannot release them.

assumptions.statement: No government department, venue, property manager, supplier, cleaner or restocking role is assumed to have committed.
assumptions.impact: A real point stays UNKNOWN until written site permission, accountable procurement, storage, daily count, cleaning/disposal and escalation duties are named.

assumptions.statement: Product access is not a complete dignity service without handwashing water, privacy, cleaning and an appropriate disposal route.
assumptions.impact: A dispenser alone cannot be marked READY; missing prerequisites shrink or stop the pilot.

assumptions.statement: The minimum event model contains no name, phone, account, face, image, cycle date, health condition, precise user trajectory, employer or individual take log.
assumptions.impact: Discovery of such fields is an immediate stop and deletion event; only point, batch, aggregate time band, count and accountable-role evidence are permitted.

assumptions.statement: Zhongzhiyuan, AI Origin and Dazhongsi are taskbook names connected to rough geometries; proposed nodes are not real toilets, workplaces, dispensers or contracts.
assumptions.impact: Field survey, title, operator, accessibility, privacy, water, drainage, cleaning, storage, fire and evacuation review precede any siting.

assumptions.statement: The 90-day sequence is a falsifiable proposal, not an announced public programme.
assumptions.impact: The pilot may remain synthetic, shrink, pause or stop when responsibility, quality, dignity, workload, cost or safety gates fail.

assumptions.statement: Aggregate forecasting may not outperform a two-bin system plus deterministic reorder rule.
assumptions.impact: AI is blind-tested after the non-AI baseline; if it does not reduce stockouts or waste without adding unsafe release, privacy risk or staff workload, AI exits while the service remains.

assumptions.statement: An individual may anonymously take one emergency unit and report an object-level issue, but does not certify products, storage, cleaning or reopening.
assumptions.impact: Government, community members and volunteers do not replace the named operator, supplier, quality, cleaning and professional responsibilities.
